theory.uz:
Vaqtni so‘rash: What time is it? — Soat necha?  Javob: It's … — Soat …
• To‘liq soat — o’clock: 3:00 — It's three o’clock.
• Yarim soat — half past: 7:30 — It's half past seven (yettidan yarim soat o‘tdi).
• Qachon? — at: I get up at seven o’clock. School starts at eight.
Kun qismlari: in the morning (ertalab), in the afternoon (tushdan keyin),
in the evening (kechqurun), at night (tunda).

Present Simple — har kuni takrorlanadigan ishlar: I get up at 7. We go to school.
he / she / it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: I play → she plays, I read → he reads.
-sh, -ch, -o dan keyin -es: wash → washes, watch → watches, go → goes, do → does.
have → has: She has breakfast at 7.
Kun tartibi: wake up, get dressed, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed.

Hafta kunlari: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
Oylar: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
Kun va oy nomlari doim bosh harf bilan yoziladi.
Predloglar: on + kun (on Monday), in + oy yoki fasl (in May, in winter).
Tartib sonlar: first (1st), second (2nd), third (3rd), fourth (4th), fifth (5th).
When is your birthday? — It's in April. It's on the fifth of April.

Inglizcha so‘z ko‘pincha eshitilganidek yozilmaydi — uni ko‘rib, yodlab olish kerak.
• Qo‘sh harflar: apple, ball, egg, tree, moon.
• Ikki harf — bitta tovush: sh (fish), ch (chair), th (three), ee (tree), oo (book).
• So‘z oxiridagi e odatda o‘qilmaydi: cake, bike, nose.
Rasmga qarang, so‘zni ichingizda ayting va harflarni tartib bilan tering.

What's the weather like? — Havo qanday?
Otdan sifat: sun → sunny (quyoshli), cloud → cloudy (bulutli), rain → rainy (yomg‘irli),
wind → windy (shamolli), snow → snowy (qorli), fog → foggy (tumanli).
Harorat: hot (issiq), warm (iliq), cool (salqin), cold (sovuq).
Fasllar: spring, summer, autumn, winter. In autumn it's cool and rainy.
Hozir bo‘layotgan ob-havo: It's raining. It's snowing. Take an umbrella!

Osmon: sun — quyosh, moon — oy, star — yulduz, cloud — bulut, rainbow — kamalak.
Ob-havo: rain — yomg‘ir, snow — qor, wind — shamol, lightning — chaqmoq.
Yer: tree — daraxt, flower — gul, grass — o‘t, leaf — barg, mountain — tog‘, sea — dengiz, island — orol.
Misol: There is a rainbow in the sky. — Osmonda kamalak bor.

title.uz: Taomlar: I like / I don't like
title.en: Food: I like / I don't like
title.ru: Еда: I like / I don't like

theory.uz:
like — yoqtirmoq: I like apples. — Men olmani yoqtiraman.  love — juda yaxshi ko‘rmoq: I love plov!
don't like — yoqtirmayman: I don't like onions.
he / she bilan: She likes pizza. He doesn't like fish.
Savol: Do you like milk? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.  Does he like tea? — Yes, he does.
Taomlar: bread, rice, soup, meat, fish, cheese, eggs, juice, honey, sweets (konfetlar), biscuits (pechene).

Sport: play football / basketball / tennis / chess; go swimming / go skating; ride a bike; do judo.
like + -ing — … ni yoqtiraman: I like swimming. She likes drawing. He doesn't like running.
can — qila olaman: I can play chess. I can't skate.  Can you swim? — Yes, I can.
-ing qo‘shish: draw → drawing, ride → riding (e tushadi), swim → swimming, jog → jogging.
What's your hobby? — My hobby is reading.

title.uz: Mening uyim: there is / there are va 's
title.en: My house: there is / are and 's
title.ru: Мой дом: there is / are и 's

theory.uz:
Xonalar: kitchen (oshxona), living room (mehmonxona), bedroom (yotoqxona), bathroom (hammom),
hall (dahliz), garden (bog‘). Britaniyada kvartira — flat.
There is + bitta narsa: There is a sofa in the living room.
There are + ko‘p narsa: There are two beds in my bedroom.
Savol: Is there a garden? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.  Are there any chairs? — Yes, there are.
's — egalik: my sister's room — opamning xonasi, Dad's car — dadamning mashinasi.

Uydagi narsalar: bed — karavot, sofa — divan, door — eshik, clock — devor soati, TV — televizor,
cup — chashka, plate — likopcha, spoon — qoshiq, key — kalit, box — quti, shower — dush.
Misol: There is a clock on the wall. The keys are on the table.
Savol: What's this? — It's a spoon. Where is the key? — It's in the box.

Joylar: park, school, hospital, bank, café, library (kutubxona), post office (pochta),
bus stop (avtobus bekati), museum (muzey).
next to — yonida, opposite — qarshisida, between — orasida, behind — orqasida, in front of — oldida.
The bank is next to the park. The café is between the bank and the library.
Yo‘l so‘rash: Excuse me, where is the museum? — Go straight on. Turn left / Turn right.

Kasblar: doctor (shifokor), nurse (hamshira), teacher (o‘qituvchi), driver (haydovchi), cook (oshpaz),
vet (veterinar), farmer (fermer), pilot (uchuvchi), dentist (tish shifokori), shop assistant (sotuvchi).
Kasb oldidan a / an: She is a nurse. He is an artist.
What does your mum do? — She's a teacher. Where does she work? — She works at a school.
-er / -or qo‘shimchasi: teach → teacher, drive → driver, act → actor.

Present Continuous — ayni paytda bo‘layotgan ish: Look! The baby is sleeping.
Tuzilishi: am / is / are + fe’l-ing: I am reading. She is singing. They are playing.
-ing qo‘shish: read → reading, make → making (e tushadi), cut → cutting, sit → sitting.
Inkor: I'm not sleeping. He isn't eating.  Savol: Is she dancing? — Yes, she is.
What are you doing? — I'm drawing a cat.

was / were — to be fe’lining o‘tgan zamoni (edi, edim).
I / he / she / it — was: I was at school yesterday. The film was funny.
we / you / they — were: We were in the park. They were happy.
Inkor: wasn't, weren't: It wasn't cold.  Savol: Were you at home? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Kalit so‘zlar: yesterday (kecha), last week (o‘tgan hafta), last Sunday, two days ago (ikki kun oldin).

Avval savolni o‘qing — matndan nimani izlash kerakligini bilasiz.
Keyin matnni sekin, diqqat bilan o‘qing va javobni matndan toping.
Savol so‘zlari: Who? — kim, Where? — qayerda, When? / What time? — qachon, soat nechada, What? — nima.
True / False: fikr matnga mos kelsa — To‘g‘ri, mos kelmasa — Noto‘g‘ri.
